import type { FileRecord } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { FormElement } from '../catalog-support.js';
/** Controlled native File store: chooser state never becomes a second successful control. */
export declare class FileUpload extends FormElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        files: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        multiple: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        accept: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        maxFiles: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        maxBytes: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        dragOver: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        failures: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    files: readonly FileRecord[];
    multiple: boolean;
    accept: string;
    maxFiles: number | undefined;
    maxBytes: number | undefined;
    private dragOver;
    private failures;
    private nextId;
    private removeFocus;
    constructor();
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(_state: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    updated(): void;
    private acceptFile;
    private add;
    private picker;
    private removeFile;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
